purpose: Targeted source-only remediation after fresh v0.8 reassurance run 36627655202 found BUS-EXT-006 educationally sound but lacking direct promotion-eligible reusable support for its ESG reporting/disclosure treatment.

source_additions.title: ESG metrics and social equity: Investigating commensurability
source_additions.date_version: Published 2022-09-21; current CC BY page checked 2026-09-29
source_additions.educational_role: Direct reusable support for distinguishing ESG information disclosure/transparency from underlying ESG performance and for teaching that ESG metrics and ratings can differ materially because methodologies, assessed elements, weighting and comparability vary.
source_additions.restrictions: Use the stable disclosure-versus-performance distinction and evidence about metric/rating comparability. Do not treat any named commercial ESG rating methodology, dataset or empirical correlation as a universal measure of sustainability performance, and do not infer that disclosure alone proves positive real-world impact.
